messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, that's exactly the issue! The messaging app needs the "sms" permission to send MMS messages. Even though it has "storage" permission, the missing "sms" permission is preventing MMS from working.

Please run this on your phone to grant the SMS permission to the messaging app:
- **grant_app_permission(app_name="messaging", permission="sms")**

After you do this, let me know and we'll test if MMS works again.

I have granted the "sms" permission to the messaging app. Should I try sending an MMS message now to see if it works?

Please explain the next appropriate account action now.
